osnet.note: Architecture source is unmodified. Use pretrained=False and load these Re-ID weights explicitly.

configuration.unencoded_policy: Current singleton, retained local binding can preserve identity

timing_protocol.clock: Host perf_counter_ns; detector boundary synchronized; encoder returns CPU-ready features
timing_protocol.core_ms: Replay, models, tracking, crops, history, projection, assignment, grouping, global identities
timing_protocol.association_block_ms: Whole identity stage, including validation and four component timings; do not add both
timing_protocol.read_decode_ms_and_rgb_conversion_ms: Subtimings inside replay_ms, also reported per camera; do not add to replay_ms
timing_protocol.record_ms: JSON serialization, buffered trace and feature writes, counters; no durability guarantee
timing_protocol.throughput: Warm loop wall time, including recording and intermediate progress; 1 round = 3 images
timing_protocol.excluded: Checksums, constructors, replay open, final stream close/flush, NPY finalization, reports
timing_protocol.warmup: First rounds processed and recorded normally; no state reset at measurement start
timing_protocol.filesystem_cache: Uncontrolled and warmed by full video checksum reads
timing_protocol.memory: PyTorch allocator peak after warmup reset; reserved includes caches retained from warmup; not total process VRAM

limits: Single sequential instrumentation run, not a final performance benchmark
Geometry/appearance/merge settings are inherited integration candidates, not independent calibration
Global identity now starts at frame 0; earlier frozen experiments started at frame 2
New detector/tracker/embedding inference; prior 86.02% IDF1 is not asserted for this run
No ground-truth evaluation or rendering in this command; evaluate recorded output separately
Raw bottom-center geometry does not detect occluded feet; local continuity can preserve incorrect IDs
